lines:
  - id: f2441.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    note: "Zero-valued money parameter for the no-credit branch of line 11."

  - id: f2441.h_qp_lived_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of listed dependents who are qualifying persons and whose main home was your home for more than half of 2025"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_lived_half, {const: true}]}
    note: "Open point: the text asks whether your home was the qualifying person's main home for more than half of 2025. This line reads it from the existing per-dependent field dependent.dc_lived_half. A qualifying person who is not a listed dependent is covered by f2441.nondependent; that question describes such a person as having lived with you for more than half of 2025."

  - id: f2441.line_a
    printed: "A"
    label: "You can't claim a credit for child and dependent care expenses if your filing status is married filing separately unless you meet the requirements listed in the instructions under Married Persons Filing Separately. If you meet these requirements, check this box"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - {op: test, ne: [household.mfs_living, {const: "together_late"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.home_cost, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, gt: [f2441.h_qp_lived_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [f2441.nondependent, {const: true}]}
    note: "The requirements are: you lived apart from your spouse during the last 6 months of 2025 (household.mfs_living is not together_late), you paid more than half the cost of keeping up the home (household.home_cost), and the home was a qualifying person's main home for more than half of 2025."

  - id: f2441.h_qp_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of listed dependents who are qualifying persons"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}

  - id: f2441.line2_box
    printed: "2 (box)"
    label: "If you have more than three qualifying persons, see the instructions and check this box"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [f2441.h_qp_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
    note: "Only qualifying persons in the dependent collection are counted. The interface gives no count of qualifying persons who are not dependents (f2441.nondependent is a yes/no answer), so those persons cannot be added to the count."

  - id: f2441.h_two_or_more
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Two or more qualifying persons"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, ge: [f2441.h_qp_count, {param: dc.persons_two}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, ge: [f2441.h_qp_count, {param: dc.one}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [f2441.nondependent, {const: true}]}
    note: "Open point: f2441.nondependent says only that there is at least one qualifying person who is not a dependent, not how many. Chosen reading: a yes answer adds exactly one person. A disabled spouse who is a qualifying person is not in the dependent collection and is not counted here."

  - id: f2441.h_limit_one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$3,000 (one qualifying person)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: dc.limit_one}

  - id: f2441.h_limit_two
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$6,000 (two or more qualifying persons)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: dc.limit_two}

  - id: f2441.line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Enter $3,000 ($6,000 if two or more qualifying persons)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.h_two_or_more, {const: true}]}
          then: f2441.h_limit_two
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.h_two_or_more, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_limit_one

  - id: f2441.h_col_d_total
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Total of the amounts in column (d) of line 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.dc_line2d
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
    note: "Assumes dependent.dc_line2d is the qualified expenses incurred and paid in 2025 for that person, before removing any benefits shown on line 28. Line 30 removes those benefits from the total. Qualifying persons who are not dependents have no column (d) amount in the interface."

  - id: f2441.h_col_d_capped
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Column (d) total, not more than $3,000 ($6,000 if two or more persons)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [f2441.h_col_d_total, f2441.line27]}

  - id: f2441.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Add the amounts in column (d) of line 2. Don't enter more than $3,000 if you had one qualifying person or $6,000 if you had two or more persons. If you completed Part III, enter the amount from line 31"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.benefits, {const: true}]}
          then: f2441.line31
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.benefits, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_col_d_capped
    note: "Part III is completed exactly when dependent care benefits were received (f2441.benefits). The $3,000/$6,000 limit is the same amount defined on line 27."

  - id: f2441.h_credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Smaller of line 9c or line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [f2441.line9c, f2441.line10]}

  - id: f2441.line11
    printed: "11"
    label: "Credit for child and dependent care expenses. Enter the smaller of line 9c or line 10 here and on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [f2441.line_a, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_zero
        - guard:
            op: test
            not:
              op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [f2441.line_a, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_credit
    note: "Line A says that on a married-filing-separately return the credit can't be claimed unless the line A requirements are met, so the credit is zero in that case. The other STOP conditions already give zero here: Credit Limit Worksheet line 3 (line 10 not more than zero) and line 29 (line 31 and line 3 then zero)."

  - id: f2441.h_paid_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualified expenses incurred and paid in 2025 for the listed qualifying persons"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.dc_paid
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}

  - id: f2441.line16
    printed: "16"
    label: "Enter the total amount of qualified expenses incurred in 2025 for the care of the qualifying person(s)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    refuses: [f2441.employer_care]
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f2441.h_paid_qp, f2441.other_care_expenses]}
    note: "The instructions say it doesn't matter when the expenses were paid. This line adds the 2025 expenses already paid for each qualifying person to the other 2025-incurred expenses (f2441.other_care_expenses, which includes unpaid ones). The value of care furnished by the employer itself is not counted as an expense in the inputs, so that case is refused."

  - id: f2441.h_spouse_earned_b
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Spouse's earned income for lines 18 and 19 (excluding dependent care benefits)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:

      collection: person

    note: "Open point: whether person.dc_earned_b applies the deemed $250/$500 a month for a student or disabled spouse (instructions for line 5) is set by that field's own definition and is not decided here."

  - id: f2441.h_mfs_deemed_gate
    printed: "(gate)"
    label: "Married filing separately, not considered unmarried, and spouse was a student or disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:

        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [f2441.line_a, {const: false}]}

    note: "The deemed monthly earned income for a student or disabled spouse can't be figured from the interface, which has no month counts. In this case line 19 is refused rather than understated."

  - id: f2441.line19
    printed: "19"
    label: "Enter the amount shown below that applies to you. If married filing jointly, enter your spouse's earned income (if you or your spouse was a student or was disabled, see the instructions for line 5). If married filing separately, see instructions. All others, enter the amount from line 18."
    type: Dollars
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    refuses: [f2441.h_mfs_deemed_gate]
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
          then: f2441.h_spouse_earned_b
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [f2441.line_a, {const: false}]}

        - guard:
            op: test
            not:
              op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
                - op: test
                  all:
                    - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [f2441.line_a, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.line18
    note: "For married filing separately, 'considered unmarried' under Married Persons Filing Separately is read from line A, which for that status holds exactly those requirements. If considered unmarried, line 18 is used; otherwise the spouse's earned income is used."

Second transcription's note: The instructions say it doesn't matter when the expenses were paid. This line adds the 2025 expenses already paid for each qualifying person to the other 2025-incurred expenses (f2441.other_care_expenses, which includes unpaid ones). The value of care furnished by the employer itself is not counted as an expense in the inputs, so that case is refused.
